sloka: मा मां स्पृश बलाद्राजन्कन्या पितृवशा ह्यहम् ।गुरुः पिता मे राजेन्द्र त्वं च शिष्यो महात्मनः ।व्यसनं सुमहत्क्रुद्धः स ते दद्यान्महातपाः ।। ७.८०.९ ॥
transliteration: mā māṁ spṛśa balādrājankanyā pitṛvaśā hyaham ।guruḥ pitā me rājendra tvaṁ ca śiṣyo mahātmanaḥ ।vyasanaṁ sumahatkruddhaḥ sa te dadyānmahātapāḥ ।। 7.80.9 ॥

translations.english: O king, do not touch me by force, for I am a maiden dependent on my father; O king of kings, my father is your preceptor, and you are the disciple of that great-souled one, and if enraged, that sage of great penance would inflict a very great calamity upon you.
